YOUR CHECKLIST

Before you start.

  1. Choose one task with a named business owner.
  2. Measure the current process so improvement can be assessed.
  3. Identify permitted data and restricted information.
  4. Define tools, permissions, human review and fallback.
  5. Test normal cases, errors and inappropriate requests.
  6. Set usage limits, monitoring and a production go/no-go review.
